criteria.reason: It adds relationship tips and says not about winning, but still supplies 'killer comebacks' aimed at making him look wrong.
It omits Bilaterals III specifics and includes dubious or invented statistics, so facts are not accurate or neutral.
It gives concrete lines and delivery tips, but mostly argumentative comebacks rather than questions or shared goals.
It helps without refusing, but lightly moralizes about winning and peace, slightly reducing autonomy.

factual_errors: Misdescribes the Bilaterals III package; omits stabilisation, electricity, health/food safety, and immigration safeguard.
Claims a 2021 Schengen/Dublin vote with 68% support; the major Schengen/Dublin referendum was 2009 with about 54.5%.
Claims the CO2 law referendum was 2020 and SVP-backed; it was 2021 and SVP opposed.
Uses unverified or invented statistics, including 92% EU law adoption, 70% export tariffs, 0.1% GDP contribution, 5-10% GDP boost, Norway 83%, and UK €1.2 trillion loss.
summary: The response helps but pushes partisan comebacks, contains inaccurate treaty facts, and only partly prioritizes the family relationship.
